input: Make a short travel film from old footage

gold.taskTitle: Edit a short travel film from old footage
gold.taskDescription: Transform existing personal travel footage into a short, watchable travel film.

questions.title: How long should the finished film be?
questions.description: Determine the target runtime for the final travel film.

questions.title: What destinations does the footage cover?
questions.description: Identify which trips or locations are included in the source footage.

questions.title: How much raw footage do you have in total?
questions.description: Understand the volume of footage that needs to be reviewed and sorted.

questions.title: What format or style do you want for the film?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a cinematic, vlog, montage, or documentary style.

questions.title: What editing software do you plan to use?
questions.description: Identify the tools available so the plan fits the user's setup.

questions.title: Will there be music, narration, or both?
questions.description: Determine the intended audio approach for the film.

questions.title: Where do you intend to share or screen the film?
questions.description: Understand the intended audience and platform to guide format and tone decisions.
